content: Dewit Piŋkop da aŋpulugosak do bɨsit agɨt
Dewit dakon kap kɨnda. Kap on do Maskil yaŋ yoŋ. Dewit tɨp kɨnamgwan egek bɨsit on mandagɨt.

content.text: Nak Yawe da aŋpulugosak do tebaisi yaŋ tɨdosot.
Bupmɨ nandaŋ namɨŋek aŋpulugosak do bɨsit asat.
Nandaba kɨkno gat ae jɨgɨ morap noman taŋ namaŋ uŋun kɨsi iyɨŋ mudosot.
Jɨgɨsi nandaŋek wagɨlsi yokwi tokdɨsat yaŋ nandɨsat bɨsapmon, Yawe niaŋsi abeŋ uŋun gak da nandɨsal.
Kosiron yokwalgeŋ do amɨn da pat pɨwit.
Nak aŋpulugosak amɨn kɨnda kapmat dɨma akban kosot.
Amɨn kɨnda da kɨlano dɨma asak, ae amɨn kɨnda da nak do bup taŋek dɨma aŋkutnosok.
Yaŋdo, Yawe nak aŋpulugoki do bɨsit gayɨsat.
Mɨktɨmon egɨsat bɨsapmon gak gat gɨn egɨp do nandɨsat.
Butno obɨsi jɨk tosok, do aŋpulugoki do bɨsit asat uŋun nandaki.
Nak aŋsopmaŋgaŋ amɨn uŋun tapmɨmni madepsi.
Arɨpmɨ dɨma pabɨŋ yopbeŋ, do uŋun da kɨsiron baŋ pulugaŋ nepbi.
Jɨgɨkon yɨkdat, do pulugaŋ nepbɨ tagɨsi egɨpbeŋ.
Yaŋ aŋaki yo tagɨsi aŋnamɨsal uŋun do nandaŋek mɨŋat amɨn kabɨyogo muwutnikon mango aŋkɨsikeŋ.
